name: The Lord of Blackrock
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details: The old feeling returns. The welcome pangs of victory reverberate throughout your being. Before you lies the monolithic, battle scarred head of Nefarian. Return it to your Highlord, champion.
narrative.objectives: Return the Head of Nefarian to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon in Stormwind.
narrative.offerRewardText: You need not be told the meaning of what you have done, adventurer. This day will be recorded in the annals of history. A victory the likes of which has not been known to the Alliance for years - if ever!

chain.subtitle: 2 quests at level 60, 19,900 XP in all.
